envelope.description: Delete the old paths and make the scan fail the build

body.title: Delete the old paths and make the scan fail the build
body.summary: First grep the whole tree for the old exports as a findings pass. Then delete runGit and team/git.ts, runGitAsync and git-async.ts, runGh, commitAndPushArtifacts and the other github.ts wrappers (keep GhCommandError, parseGithubRemoteUrl and the types the table uses in a small module), createGitRunner and runGitBinary, _setTrackerExecForTests, _legacy-table.ts, _setRegistryTableFactoryForTests and _setWorkflowToolDepsForTests; replace old-paths-unchanged.test.ts with old-paths-removed.test.ts; make package.json run the scan with --fail.
acceptanceChecks: a grep for the old exports over the whole tree is run before deleting and any caller outside the listed sites is recorded as a finding and fixed first
old-paths-removed.test.ts asserts the old exports and files are gone
node scripts/forbidden-spawn-scan.mjs --fail exits 0 on the whole tree, with only the three exemptions
package.json build runs the scan with --fail and tsc is clean

tests.name: old-paths-removed.test.ts: runGit, runGitAsync, runGh, commitAndPushArtifacts, the github.ts wrappers, createGitRunner, runGitBinary and _setTrackerExecForTests are not exported and the files are gone
build-script.test.ts: package.json build runs forbidden-spawn-scan.mjs --fail and the scan finds nothing outside the exemptions
